problem:
Consider the straight line given by the following parametric equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=13-8t \\ y=7t \\ z=-7-3t\end{aligned}
$$

What would be the vector equation of the line?
worked_solution:
These parametric equations are equivalent to 

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}13-8t \\ 7t \\ -7-3t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}13 \\ 0 \\ -7\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-8t \\ 7t \\ -3t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}13 \\ 0 \\ -7\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 7 \\ -3\end{aligned}] \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}13 \\ 0 \\ -7\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 7 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$
